definitions.explanation: The baseball club at a Japanese school or company. School baseball clubs are central to Japanese sports culture and the route to events like the National High School Baseball Championship ({甲子園|こうしえん}).

examples.japanese: {野球部|やきゅうぶ}に{入|はい}った。
{兄|あに}は{高校|こうこう}の{野球部|やきゅうぶ}でキャプテンを{務|つと}めていた。
examples.english: My older brother served as captain of his high school baseball club.

examples.japanese: {野球部|やきゅうぶ}の{練習|れんしゅう}は{朝早|あさはや}くから{夜|よる}{遅|おそ}くまで{続|つづ}くことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Baseball-club practice often runs from early morning until late at night.

notes:
Compound of {野球|やきゅう} (baseball) + {部|ぶ} (club). Most often refers to school clubs, particularly at the middle-school and high-school level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}に{入|はい}る: to join the baseball club
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}を{辞|や}める: to quit the baseball club
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}の{顧問|こもん}: faculty adviser to the baseball club
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}の{合宿|がっしゅく}: baseball-club training camp

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese high-school baseball clubs are famously demanding — daily practice, strict hierarchy by school year, and dreams of reaching {甲子園|こうしえん}. The image of the {野球部員|やきゅうぶいん} (baseball-club member) is a stock figure in Japanese media.
